idea: Create TaroKit, a personal hub of useful tools for work and everyday life. It brings together productivity utilities, developer tools, calculators, converters, and other handy resources in one clean, modern, and user-friendly interface. The platform should reflect a strong personal identity while remaining flexible and extensible for future tools and features.
